scope: Public homepage layout and interaction reconstruction for a Frame landing-page adaptation; documentation is frozen and was not edited.

sections.structure: Brand at leading edge; primary links, account actions and responsive menu. Transparent initially, background/border strengthen when scrolled.
Left-aligned large headline, short muted description and one understated announcement/action; substantial empty space above; large app presentation below.
Concise trust caption plus customer marks, followed by an oversized product-positioning statement.
Three equal open columns divided by fine vertical lines on desktop; figure labels above, illustration occupying most height, short title and paragraph below. Horizontal cards on narrower screens.
Intake/integrations; planning/monitoring; AI/automations; build/review/shipping. Each reuses the same two-column title/copy header, broad app illustration and compact feature links.
Changelog plus customer quotes/proof area. Not an additional grid of generic feature cards. Some customer presentation is hidden below laptop breakpoint.
Centered short headline with a restrained action row and generous isolation.
Fine top separator and structured link columns, collapsing from six to four to two; status, legal and theme utilities.

Feature-plus buttons call setActivePanelId with slugified labels; pointer-enter/focus preloads panel content. GlobalSidePanel reads activePanelId, keeps prior panel during transition and clears active state on close. Root confirmed a Tech Specs dialog and Escape behavior.

findings.observation: Hero line reveal declares a 0.4s initial delay plus 0.033s per line. Feature link hover brightness transition 0.16s; active scale .97. IntersectionObserver gates near-viewport loading/video playback in homepage code. These are declared behaviors; only parent supplied runtime interactions were executed.

Closing CTA is centered, gap 40px, margin-block 224px desktop/128px at<=768/96px at<=640. Footer top/bottom content padding 56px, titles separated from links 24px or16px narrow; links min-height 28px and 2px list gap.

limitations: Boundary extraction covers unshadowed JSON/global coercions plus parse and validation method candidates.
Caller-selected source analysis leaves 5 inventoried files outside analysis scope. Inventory identity covers the complete artifact; relationships through unselected sources remain unknown.
Child-process extraction covers asynchronous node:child_process creation, literal argv/env/stdio options, exit/error listeners, and kill signals.
CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
Configuration extraction covers process.env, process.argv, node:fs reads, and direct logical defaults.
Event extraction covers EventEmitter-style literal registrations, removals, and dispatch candidates; dynamic names remain unknown.
Function fingerprints are static candidates; equal digests can remain ambiguous and do not prove behavioral equivalence.
Graph coverage is incomplete; unavailable facts remain explicit and must not be read as absence.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Local data flow does not claim control-flow-sensitive reaching definitions or arbitrary dynamic property resolution.
Promise ownership covers explicit unshadowed Promise construction, static factories, aggregation, chaining, and await syntax only.
Request extraction covers fetch, WebSocket, node:http/node:https construction, direct option fields, and exact local response consumers.
Resource extraction covers built-in filesystem/network acquisition and exact local close/destroy/end handles.

Semantic node retention reached max_semantic_nodes is 1200 (default 100000; an integer from 1 to 1000000) and max_semantic_nodes_per_file is 1200 (default 20000; an integer from 1 to 1000000). Set max_semantic_nodes and max_semantic_nodes_per_file on the next analyze_javascript_application call (CLI: --max-semantic-nodes and --max-semantic-nodes-per-file). The change applies to that next analysis and does not restart the worker or the REA server. Raising them does not raise max_semantic_unknowns, max_heap_mb, transfer ceilings, or the parent result budget. Coverage reports the same effective values as semantic_graph_node_ceiling and semantic_graph_file_node_ceiling.

The change applies to that next analysis and does not restart the worker or the REA server. Omission coverage counts examined emission occurrences by family and reason, including repeats; it does not count unexamined source frontiers or distinct discarded identities.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
The semantic graph contains static syntax observations and conservative relationship candidates; it does not claim runtime execution.
Timer extraction covers global or node:timers scheduling and exact local-handle cancellation.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.

adaptation_recommendations: Keep Frame tokens, Inter font and native screenshots; adopt the section hierarchy and calm spacing rather than copying Linear branding or app mockups.
Build a left-aligned hero followed by one wide real Frame view; avoid stacks of decorative nested cards.
Use three restrained value illustrations for video/audio/images, then substantial product chapters for queue/presets, output controls and local processing.
On phones place chapter media before copy, preserve readable screenshot content through deliberate clipping, and keep horizontal value panels accessible.
Use actual documentation links for feature details instead of duplicating Linear Tech Specs modals.
Use genuine platform downloads and Frame project proof; do not invent customer logos, usage statistics or AI features.
Limit application changes strictly to the landing page.
